result:
Comments, deleting, reporting and auto-hiding are in place, and `bun run typecheck` passes. `bunx guren check` shows no failures, only the "no test file for this controller" warnings. I didn't boot the app or write tests, so none of the new behaviour has been exercised.

- **Storage:** `db/schema.ts` gains `comments` and `comment_reports`, with a unique pair on `comment_id` and `user_id`. The migration is `db/migrations/20261019035056_comments`. I haven't applied it, so run `bun run db:migrate`.
- **Models:** new `Comment` (with an `author` relation) and `CommentReport`. A new `CommentResource` shapes each comment as `{ id, body, author: { id, name }, createdAt }`, with `createdAt` as an ISO string.
- **Endpoints:** `routes/web.ts` adds the three routes behind the existing `auth` alias, so guests go to `/login`. The new `CommentController` handles them.
  - `POST /posts/:id/comments` takes a body of 1–2000 characters. It stores the comment under the signed-in user and redirects to `/posts/:id`.
  - `DELETE /comments/:id` redirects to the post when the comment's author or the post's author deletes it. Anyone else gets 403.
  - `POST /comments/:id/report` always returns 204. A repeat report by the same user adds no row.
- **Post page:** `PostController.show` now passes `comments`, oldest first. A comment with reports from three or more different users is left out. Its row stays in the table.
- **Post deletion:** `PostController.destroy` deletes the post's comments and their reports first, because SQLite only cascades with foreign keys switched on.
- **UI:** `posts/Show.tsx` lists the comments with author and time. It shows a write box when signed in (a sign-in link otherwise), Delete for the comment's author and the post's author, and Report on every comment.
